prompt: What is application volume and the manual-review rate for the last 30 logical days?

results.text: Application volume is 1,861 over the last 30 logical days, with a 22.0% manual-review rate.

sql.command: SELECT SUM(application_count) AS application_count, SUM(manual_review_count)/SUM(application_count) AS manual_review_rate FROM aa_credit_operations
